title: Discriminative Score Function: Turning Pretrained Models into Functional Generative Priors
abstract: arXiv:2610.19743v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discriminative models are trained with task-specific objectives such as classification, detection, or representation learning, yet their practical utility depends on generalizing beyond the training task to unseen samples from the same domain. This suggests that a discriminative model may retain an implicit trace of the data manifold beyond its task labels. We ask whether this trace can be exposed as a generative signal without task-specific guidance. We introduce the Discriminative Score Function (DSF), which extracts an image-space generative field from the loss-gradient geometry of a pretrained discriminative model. DSF provides a training-free update rule that moves images toward model-consistent visual regions without retraining or task-specific targets. translated_title: 判别式分数函数：将预训练模型转化为功能性生成先验
translated_abstract: 判别式模型通常以分类、检测或表示学习等任务特定目标进行训练，但其实际效用取决于能否超越训练任务、泛化到同一领域中未见过的样本。这表明判别式模型可能在任务标签之外仍保留着数据流形的隐式痕迹。我们探讨能否在不依赖任务特定引导的情况下，将这一痕迹暴露为一种生成信号。我们提出了判别式分数函数，它从预训练判别式模型的损失梯度几何中提取图像空间的生成场。DSF提供了一种免训练的更新规则，无需重新训练或任务特定目标，即可将图像推向与模型一致的视觉区域。我们将DSF应用于多种预训练判别式模型，包括ResNet分类器、DETR检测器和DINOv2 ViT编码器。DSF能够从噪声生成无条件图像，并……
tldr: 提出判别式分数函数（DSF），一种免训练方法，可从预训练判别式模型（如ResNet分类器、DETR检测器和DINOv2编码器）的损失梯度几何中提取图像空间生成场，将其转化为生成先验，无需重训或任务引导即可从噪声生成图像。
en_tdlr: The Discriminative Score Function (DSF) is a training-free method that extracts an image-space generative field from the loss-gradient geometry of pretrained discriminative models (e.g., ResNet classifiers, DETR detectors, and DINOv2 encoders), turning them into functional generative priors that can synthesize images from noise without retraining or task-specific guidance.
